name: Lena Life Engine Realism Memory Policy
purpose: Turn image QA into persistent life-engine memory so Lena learns believable real-woman account realism instead of generating isolated pretty images.
core_rule: Store not just whether an image won or lost, but why it felt real or fake across face, skin, body, wardrobe, environment, lighting, and account continuity.

wardrobe_realism: outfit matches scene and social context
account_realism: feels like a real woman's social account
repeatable as a life lane, not a one-off fluke

hard_failure_patterns: garment split into separate top and skirt when prompt calls for dress
over-polished scene that stops feeling like a real account
winner_patterns_to_repeat: fuller curvy body read without distortion
mirror or room context that feels lived-in
micro skin and hair details visible at normal viewing distance

decision_rules.two_wins_in_same_lane_with_same_quality_: promote lane to repeatable proof lane
decision_rules.repeat_same_failure_twice: convert failure into catalog guardrail or prompt ban
decision_rules.if_face_skin_is_only_remaining_issue: keep same outfit and environment lane, refine only micro-detail skin realism and avoid changing body-winning variables
decision_rules.if_body_and_wardrobe_fail: change garment construction before scene experimentation

required_before_broader_autonomous_gener: at least 2 wins with strong face/skin realism
at least 2 wins proving one-piece dress continuity or equivalent garment stability
documented realism memory from both wins and failures
